sections.shortTitle: Rulers of Acceding States Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIX OF 2017
ACT XXXIX OF 2017
RULERS OF ACCEDING STATES (ABOLITION OF PRIVY PURSES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Rulers of Acceding States
(Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
31st December, 2017]
No. F.
22(7)12017-Legis, dated 29.12.2017.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 27th
December, 2017 is hereby Published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy
Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 15 of 1972), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Rulers of Acceding
States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

ACT XXXIX OF 2017
ACT XXXIX OF 2017

An Act further to amend the Rulers of Acceding States
(Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
31st December, 2017]
No. F.
22(7)12017-Legis, dated 29.12.2017.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 27th
December, 2017 is hereby Published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy
Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 15 of 1972), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of Article
5, Order 15 of 1972.---In the Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy
Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 15 of 1972), in Article 5, after
clause (2), the following new clause shall be added, namely:-
"(3)
Notwithstanding anything contained in clause (1) and subject to clause (2), the
Federal Government may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, increase
maintenance allowance of a Ruler or, as the case may be, a dependent of a
Ruler.".
